weighted_score_method: sum(category_score * category_weight); raw 8.04, rounded to one decimal for display.
strengths: The street-facing entry is now legible with glazed door, canopy, landing, address plaque and readable practice sign; preview trees no longer hide it.
The eight-node OSM ring is preserved around the same source-derived local origin, and the low elongated footprint is consistent with the available low-resolution street preview.
Facade reveals, varied window groups, wall returns, roof and concrete procedural variation are more visible; blue-gray glazing is no longer near-black.
The roof-off view clearly presents a reception zone and four treatment bays with more detailed chairs, casework, sinks, doors and ceiling task panels.
The export collection is stable, local-coordinate, freshly reopened, and free of missing external texture dependencies.
limitations: No authoritative facade photo, measured architectural elevations, or floor plan was located; facade openings, entry position, sign panel, roof form and height remain inferred.

The side/rear view still reads as a largely blank generic wall with sparse windows, and the overall exterior remains a simple low parapet office rather than a strongly identifiable architectural design.

The interior is visibly improved but remains schematic; clinical equipment and room arrangement are not source-backed, and the roof-off view is a top-down presentation rather than an eye-level interior view.
This review did not assess the asset’s placement in the campus master; the master marker must use origin [-702.407752, 2039.751270] m if accepted.
